prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Weather _____, we will have the picnic on Sunday.
options: permitting
permitted
permit

wrong.permitted: 天氣是「允許」的主動者，不是被允許，所以不用過去分詞。
wrong.permit: 獨立分詞構句要用分詞形式，不能用動詞原形。

why: Weather permitting 是慣用語，意思是「天氣許可的話」。
tip: weather permitting 是天氣允許的話。
say: Weather permitting, we will have the picnic on Sunday.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The work _____, the workers went home.
options: finished
finishing
finish

wrong.finishing: 工作是「被完成」，不是自己完成別的事，要用被動意思的過去分詞。
wrong.finish: 獨立分詞構句要用分詞，不能用動詞原形。

why: 工作被完成了，主詞 work 與分詞是被動關係，用 finished。
tip: 主詞被完成，用過去分詞。
say: The work finished, the workers went home.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Generally speaking, boys are taller than girls at that age.
Generally speaked, boys are taller than girls at that age.
General speaking, boys are taller than girls at that age.
answer: Generally speaking, boys are taller than girls at that age.

wrong.Generally speaked, boys are taller than: speak 的過去分詞是 spoken，而且這個慣用語固定用 speaking。
wrong.General speaking, boys are taller than g: 修飾 speaking 要用副詞 generally，不能用形容詞 general。

why: generally speaking 是固定的慣用分詞片語，意思是「一般來說」。
say: Generally speaking, boys are taller than girls at that age.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: All things considered, it was a good trip.
options: 全部考量過後，這趟旅行還不錯
所有東西都被遺忘了，這趟旅行很棒
考慮過後，這趟旅行被取消了
answer: 全部考量過後，這趟旅行還不錯

wrong.考慮過後，這趟旅行被取消了: 句中說 it was a good trip，旅行已經進行，沒有被取消。

why: all things considered 是慣用語，意思是「整體考量之後」。
tip: all things considered 是整體來看。
say: All things considered, it was a good trip.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: It _____ Sunday, the shops were closed.
options: being
was
been

wrong.was: 獨立分詞構句不能再用有時態的動詞，否則會變成兩個完整句子只用逗號連接。
wrong.been: been 是過去分詞，不能單獨放在這裡，要用 being 表示當時的狀態。

why: It being Sunday 是獨立分詞構句，表示原因：因為是星期日。
tip: 獨立分詞構句用 being，不用 was。
say: It being Sunday, the shops were closed.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Judging from his accent, he must be from Texas.
Judge from his accent, he must be from Texas.
To judging from his accent, he must be from Texas.
answer: Judging from his accent, he must be from Texas.

wrong.Judge from his accent, he must be from T: 這個慣用語要用現在分詞 judging，不是動詞原形。
wrong.To judging from his accent, he must be f: to 後面要接原形，to judging 文法不通。

why: judging from 是慣用懸置分詞，意思是「從…來判斷」。
say: Judging from his accent, he must be from Texas.

prompt: 你想說「因為天氣不好，比賽取消了」。哪一句最適合？
options: The weather being bad, the game was canceled.
The weather bad being, the game was canceled.
Being the weather bad, the game was canceled.
answer: The weather being bad, the game was canceled.

wrong.The weather bad being, the game was canc: 字序錯誤，being 要放在名詞後、形容詞前。
wrong.Being the weather bad, the game was canc: 獨立分詞構句要保留主詞在前面，順序是 主詞 + being + 補語。

why: 獨立分詞構句的順序是：主詞 + being + 形容詞。
tip: 獨立分詞構句：主詞在前，being 在後。
say: The weather being bad, the game was canceled.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
options: 嚴格來說，番茄是水果
說話很嚴格的人，把番茄當水果
嚴格要求大家買番茄

wrong.說話很嚴格的人，把番茄當水果: strictly speaking 是慣用語，不是在描述某個說話嚴格的人。
wrong.嚴格要求大家買番茄: 句中沒有要求買東西的意思。

why: strictly speaking 意思是「嚴格來說」，修飾整句話。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The teacher _____ the room, the students stood up.
options: entering
entered
to enter

wrong.entered: 用過去式 entered，兩個子句只靠逗號連接，是文法錯誤；獨立分詞構句要用分詞。
wrong.to enter: to enter 是不定詞，不能引導表示時間的獨立分詞構句。

why: 老師進入教室的同時學生起立，用 the teacher entering 表示時間。
tip: 獨立分詞構句用 V-ing 表示同時。
say: The teacher entering the room, the students stood up.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: With her eyes closed, she made a wish.
With closed her eyes, she made a wish.
With her eyes close, she made a wish.
answer: With her eyes closed, she made a wish.

with 後面的順序是 名詞 + 分詞，不能把分詞放在名詞前面。
眼睛是被閉上的，要用過去分詞 closed，close 是原形或形容詞（靠近）。

why: with + 名詞 + 過去分詞，表示附帶的被動狀態。
tip: with 加名詞加分詞，描述附帶狀態。
say: With her eyes closed, she made a wish.

prompt: 你想開誠布公地說「老實說，我不喜歡這部電影」。哪一句最自然？
options: Frankly speaking, I don't like this movie.
Frankly spoken, I don't like this movie.
Frankly to speak, I don't like this movie.
answer: Frankly speaking, I don't like this movie.

慣用語是 speaking，不是過去分詞 spoken。
wrong.Frankly to speak, I don't like this movi: 這個說法不存在，要說 frankly speaking 或 to be frank。

why: frankly speaking 是慣用語，意思是「坦白說」。
say: Frankly speaking, I don't like this movie.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ his age, he runs remarkably fast.
options: Considering
Considered
Consider

wrong.Considered: considered 是被動意思，但這裡是「考慮到他的年紀」，要用 considering。
wrong.Consider: 這個慣用法要用現在分詞，不能用原形。

why: considering 是慣用語，意思是「就…來說、考慮到」。
say: Considering his age, he runs remarkably fast.
